snippet.title: PSX Longplay [197] Ray Tracers (US)
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Mad-Matt

US Version of Ray Tracers. Mostly the same as the Japanese version but without the in game banter and the Animation sequences are in English. The game has more than a hint of taito's chase hq gameplay. I have wanted to record this for along time and I present here a 100% run of the game, although it does get a bit boring when you have to replay all the tracks with every character.

I open the video showing both intro sequences which you normally see if you wait on the title screen. Each time the game is complete the credits are played. I cut these and just let it play at the end of the video. This version of the game also supports volume adjustment and by default the sfx is way too high blocking out all of the music.

00:00:00 - Intro

00:03:30 -  First run through the game using Sleoteel (Blue Hawk Car) played on Hard.

00:26:00 - Played on Normal with J-Lang (Red Spanker Car)

00:47:00 - Played on Normal with Asuka (Yellow Lynx Car)

01:07:30 - Played on Normal with Blody (Green Buffalo Car)

01:26:48 - Maki is now unlocked and played. (White Vestal Car)

01:44:12 - Kaiser is now unlocked and played in Time Attack mode (Black B-Vestal Car) against Tsumuji (Purple Tsumujikaze Car).

01:48:06 -  Tsumuji unlocked and story played (Purple Tsumujikaze Car).

02:06:18 -  Hard Mode playing as Kaiser (Black B-Vestal car). Finishing this concludes the game, plays the credits and unlocks the Movie player allowing you to watch all the cut scenes in the game.

02:27:31 -  Showing the remaining tracks in Time Attack mode. -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
